submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively on the token that completes a familiar multi-token chunk: a non-initial subword piece of a split word (red+isc+overed, af+stand, rep+ud+iated, dal+am) or the closing word of a stock collocation (FA Cup, been held, were searched, final match). It stays quiet when the same letters or tokens appear without the constraining prefix, including nonce splits (xyzqwt pieces all ~0), broken collocations (trophy for Cup, seen for held), and chunk-initial uses of the same word (Match 0.30 vs match 1.52; searched 0.41 active-voice vs 1.25 passive).
